title: Workspace shell
deliverable: Add responsive resizable panes, themes, remembered non-sensitive preferences and command navigation.
acceptance: Layout remains usable at narrow widths and high zoom; theme preference does not capture input content.
strict_verification: Workspace tasks remain keyboard-accessible and responsive during worker load; local/remote/persistence effects are visibly distinct.

title: Recipe editing
deliverable: Add drag/drop with keyboard alternatives, undo/redo, duplicate, disable, reorder and parameter validation.
acceptance: Editing preserves stable node identities and annotations; purely visual movement does not rerun processing.
strict_verification: Undo/redo/reorder/disable/import edits preserve one IR and semantic revisions; secret parameters/history are redacted and imports remain inert.

title: Generated operation inspector
deliverable: Render argument forms, examples, defaults, capability warnings and semantic-version details from descriptors.
acceptance: New descriptors require no handwritten duplicate API schema or form definition for supported field types.
strict_verification: Typed forms match descriptor defaults/enums/ranges; invalid values fail before running, and secret fields never enter ordinary saved UI state.

title: Safe automatic preview
deliverable: Add debounced, bounded previews for permitted pure operations and an explicit full-run action.
acceptance: Imported recipes and effectful/expensive operations never start merely because they were pasted or opened.
strict_verification: Only approved pure cheap previews autorun; sample/input/output/work caps hold, stale generations drop, and reductions are visibly partial.

title: Paged text viewer
deliverable: Add incremental decoding, line indexing, search, selection and bounded text previews.
acceptance: Large single lines and invalid UTF sequences do not force a full document string allocation.
strict_verification: Page through split codepoints and extremely long lines at exact offsets; bounded decoding/cache/search survives cancellation without whole-file strings.

title: Virtual hex viewer
deliverable: Add range-backed hex/ASCII viewing, exact offset navigation, selection and export.
acceptance: Offsets above 32-bit ranges remain correct; UI memory is measured separately from underlying artifact storage.
strict_verification: Use synthetic range/DTO boundaries beyond 2^53 plus actual feasible large-artifact pages; offsets stay lossless, out-of-range JS indices reject, and DOM/cache/export work is bounded. No multi-petabyte browser file claim follows from synthetic offset tests.

title: Structured and table viewers
deliverable: Add lossless tree/table views, typed cell rendering, pagination and safe copy/export.
acceptance: Large integers and binary values remain exact; untrusted strings cannot inject markup or spreadsheet formulas without warning.
strict_verification: Lossless numbers/records and bounded nesting/rows render as inert DOM; hostile fields, infinite tables, and stale page updates cannot escape limits.

title: Graph editor
deliverable: Add an optional visual graph for typed ports, branches, joins and structured control regions.
acceptance: Invalid edges are rejected by the engine compiler, not only by visual UI rules; keyboard editing remains possible.
strict_verification: Linear/graph editing round trips through one IR; loop regions remain explicit and keyboard/DOM alternatives cover essential graph tasks.

title: Debugging controls
deliverable: Add breakpoints, single-step, node diagnostics, intermediate inspection and cancellation status.
acceptance: Viewing a preview does not prematurely terminate a full output stream or leak a secret artifact into history.
strict_verification: Breakpoints/single-step/cached steps preserve ordering and generation; inspection caps and sensitivity rules prevent history/preview leakage.

title: Offset provenance UI
deliverable: Show source/output correspondences where transformations provide them, including encoded-byte relationships.
acceptance: Non-local or lossy transforms say unmappable/approximate explicitly rather than invent exact positions.
strict_verification: Exact/approximate/unavailable mappings are distinguished; selection through expanding/contracting operations never invents source positions.

title: Multiple inputs and batches
deliverable: Add named inputs, file sets, deterministic batch ordering and per-item error policy.
acceptance: A failed batch item cannot silently discard other results; files are not duplicated into UI state.
strict_verification: Bound concurrent inputs, batch queues, aggregate bytes and outputs; one failed/cancelled item follows declared isolation/ordering policy.

title: Local recipe library
deliverable: Add folders/tags, favourites, search, revision history and exportable local workspaces.
acceptance: Persistence is opt-in for sensitive data; recipe export omits secrets and bulk inputs by default.
strict_verification: Opt-in local recipe saves survive transaction completion and migration; payload literals/secrets are rejected/redacted and default runs persist nothing. Recipe documents may contain payload literals and secret parameters: inspect/redact/reject them at serialization, not just metadata projection.

title: Sharing and imports
deliverable: Support recipe-only links/files, explicit input inclusion, compatibility links and import previews.
acceptance: Users see capabilities and embedded data before running; history and URL exposure are clearly distinguished.
strict_verification: Hostile/unknown/versioned imports fail explicitly; URL sharing excludes payload/secrets and requires a deliberate action, with no import autorun.

title: Offline packaging
deliverable: Cache versioned app assets and selected operation packs; provide a complete offline distribution option.
acceptance: Offline operation availability is visible; service-worker upgrades cannot mix incompatible engine and pack revisions.
strict_verification: A selected complete offline pack set runs with networking disabled; integrity/versions/licenses agree and no model/font/CDN request escapes.

title: Browser accessibility gate
deliverable: Test keyboard, screen reader, focus, reduced motion, high contrast and touch-friendly responsive layouts.
acceptance: Core tasks work without canvas-only controls, GPU acceleration, shared memory or a mouse.
strict_verification: Essential real-browser workflows pass keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, narrow-layout and error recovery checks; graph/canvas have alternatives.
